info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Claringb Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Claringb Jacket Detail Submission API allows users to add new details about the Claringb jacket to the catalog. This API is essential for managing product information and enhancing the online shopping experience. Ideal for e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems, it supports the seamless integration of product specifics. Retailers can utilize this API to ensure that their catalog is up-to-date and accurately reflects the offerings available to consumers.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new set of details for the Claringb jacket. Ensure that all required information is provided in the request body to successfully create the details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send details about the claringb jacket for processing. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request to avoid errors.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested jacket details.

claringb_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Claringb jacket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the Claringb jacket.

quantity.description: The number of Claringb jackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Claringb jacket.
